title: Testing out GPT-Live-1 to make my colonists come to life
author: cody-fifth-door

comments.author: MapApprehensive1867
comments.body: What is gpt live 1 and what's its cost. You are using API I assume

comments.author: waypostmaster
comments.body: Oooo, I want this. Say more (I think we’re making the same game lol)

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body:
Haha sort of! 

I've also wanted this type of game for a while. Basically Dwarf Fortress/Rimworld but made for 3D with a first person mode and (optionally) LLMs driving the settlers/colonists.

This is actually my third of so time attempting this concept but it feels like I'm actually able to make great progress now that we have Astra's great spatial understanding. It can really work voxels.

replies.author: waypostmaster
replies.body: Is it playable at the site yet?

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body:
Yup! 

You can play it here: [https://play.beta.fifthdoor.com/play/hearth-and-hollow](https://play.beta.fifthdoor.com/play/hearth-and-hollow)

Though I don't have the LLM integration live yet.

replies.author: Standard_Egg3504
replies.body: i want this but with FTL/Save Our Ship + Shores of Hazeron style systems/bodies/travel, and an X series type economy that doesn't 'cheat' in resources bolted on

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body:
I was just thinking I wanted a game where you play as a captain dictating to your crew on real time from the bridge. 

"Divert all power to the forward shield generators, ready photon torpedos, try to hail"

replies.author: gefahr
replies.body: Oh that's a great idea for a voice controlled game.

replies.author: waypostmaster
replies.body:
That’s basically Star Trek: Bridge Simulator :)

I want a Tom Clancy’s EndWar remake, on the subject of voice commands

comments.author: xhatsux
comments.body: This is amazing.  I have been thinking a lot about how to use AI actually as in game experience.  Also obsessed with voxels, so good mix for me. I want how the pricing/subscriptions would have to be for these in the future.

replies.body: If youre talking about the AzerothCore player bots, you can use Ollama self hosted. If you want to use this... just have an LLM set it up for you.

replies.author: Shppo
replies.body: already got ollama self-hosted running will try that thanks!

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body:
Thanks! Lot's of opportunities here I think. 

The implementation itself needs a lot of work to feel really immersive.
